verdict.rationale: Devin exposes a documented API for creating sessions programmatically and 'automating workflows' (devin-docs-8, devin-docs-9), and a CLI is documented (devin-probe-4), which together imply headless/scriptable invocation suitable for CI/CD or shell scripts. However, there is no explicit documentation or example of running Devin inside a CI/CD pipeline, GitHub Actions, or shell script, nor any exit-code/non-interactive mode described. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline integration guide, headless/non-interactive CLI mode documentation, and independent evidence of real-world CI/CD usage.
